There’re use cases when SD 2.5 is superior. It’s good to have both models.

I feel like the debate over AI in academic journals is way too focused on where the capabilities of AI are today (or even where they were a couple years ago) and not nearly focused on where they will almost certainly be in the coming years…

… and publication takes many years.

When making AI video remember that first 3-5 seconds are crucial. Most people will scroll through if it’s too slow or not captivating. Spend extra time making your intro. Most of the time, it’s too slow or too boring for people to keep watching.
